zh.summary: 可选内核不再被 alpha 挤掉 RC，并更新默认插件以支持最新内核。
highlights: 可选内核仍是最新三个，但当最新三个全是 alpha 时，会保留最新的 RC 或正式版，不再被挤出。
默认插件更新：图片查看 0.1.10、聊天管理 1.5.11，支持官方 0.2.1-alpha.3 内核。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。

en.summary: Alphas no longer push the release candidate out of the selectable cores, and the default plugins now support the newest core.
highlights: The selectable cores are still the newest three, but when all three newest are alphas the newest release candidate or final stays in the list.
Default plugins updated: Image Viewer 0.1.10 and Chat Manager 1.5.11, supporting the official 0.2.1-alpha.3 core.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace.
